Life is full of small surprises. Last Wednesday, Grace and Anna went to the train station. Grace is reading a book about music. Also, the cheap copy is clearly inferior to the original.

Grace plays tennis with Anna every Wednesday. Grace thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the train station by bike. For example, take the underground to the museum.
Grace is going to travel to Chengdu in May. Anna is interested in dancing. The train station is one of the best places in the city. Also, the old district has narrow streets.
Grace hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Both of them like chicken and coffee. There are always many people at the airport.
